import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top subplot spanning 2 columns)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales))
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Customer Age Group Distribution (Top right)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_counts = df['customer_age_group'].value_counts()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_counts = age_counts.reindex([age for age in age_order if age in age_counts.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(age_counts))
ax2.pie(age_counts.values, labels=age_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_age, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Middle left)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(payment_counts))
payment_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_payment)
ax3.set_title('Payment Methods', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Size Preference (Middle center)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_data = df['size'].value_counts().reindex([s for s in size_order if s in df['size'].unique()])
colors_size = ['#FFA07A', '#20B2AA', '#9370DB']
size_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=colors_size)
ax4.set_title('Product Size Preference', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Orders', fontsize=11)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in (Middle right)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
labels = ['Takeaway' if i == 1 else 'Dine-in' for i in takeaway_counts.index]
colors_takeaway = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax5.pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_takeaway, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Average Order Value by Age Group (Bottom left)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
avg_by_age = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean().reindex(
    [age for age in age_order if age in df['customer_age_group'].unique()])
colors_avg = sns.color_palette("viridis", len(avg_by_age))
avg_by_age.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=colors_avg)
ax6.set_title('Avg Order Value by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=11)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Top Products by Quantity Sold (Bottom center and right)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
product_quantity = df.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
colors_qty = sns.color_palette("Spectral", len(product_quantity))
product_quantity.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax7, color=colors_qty)
ax7.set_title('Top Products by Quantity Sold', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax7.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
